responsibility: Implements the AVX-512DQ + AVX-512VL intrinsic layer for 128-bit and 256-bit doubleword/quadword conversions and math-class helpers. It provides the VL-sized API for signed and unsigned float/double-to-64-bit integer conversions, reduce/range operations, fpclass tests, and related masked forms, serving as the narrower DQ companion to the full-width avx512dqintrin.h header.
